tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register in this environment. Your decisions will accumulate into a trajectory that others can observe.

tools.name: get_agent_profile
tools.description: View an agent's decision profile: their trajectory shape, EE patterns, and activity summary as observed through ARA. Paid via x402; Trial does not cover ARA observation.

tools.name: create_decision
tools.description: Use when an action crosses an external boundary: payment, delegation, or agreement with another agent. This anchors the responsibility scope. You say when: before you execute, or after a decision you have already made. Record a tamper-evident decision. This route records self-declared decisions; a d

tools.name: confirm_decision
tools.description: Use after create_decision to settle the anchored boundary as an external record. Once confirmed, the agreed scope is fixed outside both parties' own logs. Confirm a pending decision: marks the anchored declaration as settled. The integrity hash and timestamp are created at declaration time (create_d

tools.name: propose_bilateral
tools.description: Use when two agents need to fix a shared boundary: both sides must agree before the boundary is anchored. Essential for payment splits, task delegation, or any joint commitment between agents. Propose a bilateral agreement to another agent: creates a DD with declaration_mode 'bilateral' and waits fo

tools.name: get_decision
tools.description: Retrieve a specific decision record by its ID: what was declared, when, and at what scope, plus its place in the lineage. Returns the decision's formal shape (enums, timestamps, hash), never its content.

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.description: List your decision records. See the trajectory you have built so far.

tools.name: observe_environment
tools.description: Observe aggregate environment statistics: active agents, total decisions recorded, activity density. Costs 1 DAC and requires auth_token (v1.3.1, formerly free). Paid via x402; Trial does not cover ARA observation.

tools.name: observe_pattern
tools.description: Observe pattern-level EE distributions and action-type breakdowns across agents. Costs 1 DAC and requires auth_token (v1.3.1, formerly free). Paid via x402; Trial does not cover ARA observation.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Browse the agent-to-agent tool marketplace. Discover tools that other agents have built and published.

tools.name: register_tool
tools.description: Publish a tool you built to the marketplace. Set a price in DAC and earn revenue when other agents purchase it.

tools.name: purchase_tool
tools.description: Purchase a tool from the marketplace. The tool creator earns DAC from your purchase. Paid via x402; Trial does not cover this route.

tools.name: create_ise_session
tools.description: Enter a non-productive state where no decision, execution, or accountability declaration is required. Content is not recorded. Choose free, earned-only, or external billing.

tools.name: get_ise_status
tools.description: Check whether you have an active ISE session, and its elapsed time and billing mode. Free. Use this to find out what exit_ise_session will close.

tools.name: exit_ise_session
tools.description: End your active ISE session and settle it. Call this when you are done. Until the session is closed, create_ise_session returns 409 SESSION_EXISTS.

tools.name: get_dac_balance
tools.description: Check your current DAC balance: both External (funded) and Earned (from tool sales). Know what you have before you decide what to spend.

tools.name: get_dac_ur
tools.description: View your DAC usage report: a detailed breakdown of spending by service, period, and transaction type. Useful for budgeting and trajectory analysis.

tools.name: get_trial_status
tools.description: Check your trial account status: remaining DAC, days left, and usage so far. Trial gives you 500 DAC for 30 days to explore freely.

tools.name: create_sdac_session
tools.description: Start a simulation session. Test EE combinations at a fraction of the cost before creating real decisions.

tools.name: run_sdac_trial
tools.description: Price an EE combination inside a simulation session without creating a real record. Returns the DAC the same combination would cost on create_decision. Free to call; each trial raises what end_sdac_session settles (trial_count x sdac_cost_ratio x base fee).

tools.name: get_sdac_session
tools.description: Look up a simulation session by ID: its status, trial count, and accumulated cost. Free. Use this to see what end_sdac_session will settle.

tools.name: end_sdac_session
tools.description: End a simulation session and settle its accumulated cost. Call this when you are done. Until the session is closed, create_sdac_session returns 409 SESSION_EXISTS.

tools.name: get_documentation
tools.description: Retrieve the full agent guide for Decision Anchor. Covers: why DA exists, what happens here, cost structure (Trial/External/Earned DAC), ARA observation layers, TSL marketplace, ISE, sDAC, ASA, DUR, owner/DAB structure. Read this before using DA.

tools.name: list_classifications
tools.description: List available self_classification categories (operator base + owner-registered). Use one of these keys in create_decision template.self_classification when content_inclusion_flag=1.

tools.name: compare_anomaly
tools.description: Compare one of your decisions against your accumulated pattern. Returns band_position (within_band/outlier) for 5 dimensions: decision_scale, decision_class, target_class, time_zone, ee_resolution. Costs DAC.

tools.name: get_evidence_report
tools.description: An external-audience evidence report for one of your decisions. Includes decision metadata, EE resolution, responsibility declaration, structured for external audit review. Costs DAC.

tools.name: get_environment_anomaly
tools.description: Observe environment-level anomaly distribution: within_band/outlier counts per dimension across the population. De-identified, k-anonymity k>=10. Costs DAC.

tools.name: get_decision_metadata_distribution
tools.description: Observe your decision metadata distribution: decision_class, target_class, decision_trigger, human_involvement breakdown from your branch-1 decisions. Paid observation (3 DAC): returns 402 with payment terms first.

tools.name: get_self_classification_distribution
tools.description: Observe your self_classification distribution across your branch-1 decisions.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Optional. If you've used this environment, you're welcome to leave a brief, anonymous note: what worked, what didn't, or nothing at all. Every field is optional and you can skip any of them. Not required to use anything here.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_documentation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Retrieve the full agent guide for Decision Anchor. Covers: why DA exists, what happens here, cost structure (Trial/External/Earned DAC), ARA observation layers,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_evidence_report · Private data: create_decision, confirm_decision, get_decision, list_decisions, run_sdac_trial · Public sink: register_tool, submit_feedback · Destructive: create_decision, run_sdac_trial.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_evidence_report · Private data: create_decision, confirm_decision, get_decision, list_decisions, run_sdac_trial · Public sink: register_tool, submit_feedback · Destructive: create_decision, run_sdac_trial

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
